name: SnapInspect
positioning: Property inspection app and software for property managers, real estate professionals and inspectors, online or offline.
description: SnapInspect is a mobile and web application for recording property inspections. Inspectors capture photos and condition data on a phone or tablet, with or without a connection, and the platform assembles them into a report using a customisable template. It covers residential and commercial portfolios, and publishes an API and a set of integrations with property management systems.
real_estate_use: A property manager running move-in, move-out and periodic inspections across a portfolio replaces a paper checklist and a camera roll with one pass on a phone: each room and item is scored, photographed and annotated on site, and the report leaves before the inspector does. The point of buying it is the report, not the checklist — turnaround between the visit and a document the owner or tenant can act on is what the manual process loses. Teams handling HUD-assisted multifamily use it to score units against the NSPIRE standard, which is the case where the inspection is a regulatory obligation rather than an internal habit.
features: Mobile inspection capture with offline mode
Photo and video evidence attached per item
NSPIRE condition scoring for assisted housing
Public API and property management integrations

use_cases.job: Run move-in and move-out inspections and issue the report the same day
Score units against a regulatory inspection standard and keep the evidence
